narrative.coaching_note: El cambio más importante es hacer higiene de manos cuando sale de la zona del paciente, después de tocar el bed rail A y el call button. Usted tocó el bed rail A a los 0.5 segundos con la bare hand y eso pasó la contaminación a su mano. Después tocó el call button a los 3.4 segundos y luego el phone a los 6.6 segundos, y la contaminación llegó a esos dos objetos. Por eso se marcó el Momento 5 a los 5.8 segundos. La próxima vez, haga higiene de manos antes de ponerse los guantes y no toque el phone con la gloved hand puesta, como pasó a los 19.3 segundos. Si usa alcohol, frote por los 20 segundos completos para que funcione contra MRSA.
narrative.audit_summary: Staged clip with MRSA source bed rail A. Bare hand contacted bed rail A at 0.5 s, transferring contamination to bare hand, then to call button at 3.4 s and phone at 6.6 s. Gloved hand contacted bed rail A at 11.1 s after donning. Two Moment 5 opportunities were missed at 5.8 s (bare hand) and 18.7 s (gloved hand); compliance 0/2 overall and 0/2 for Moment 5, with no Moment 1, 2, or 4 opportunities. No hand hygiene events occurred; alcohol rub is effective against MRSA per record. Glove use issues included no hygiene before donning at 10.9 s and gloved contact with healthcare-area phone at 19.3 s. End-state contamination included bare hand, gloved hand, bed rail A, call button, and phone. Disinfect bed rail A, call button, and phone; Use an EPA List H registered disinfectant (effective against MRSA).
narrative.top_fix: The highest-impact single change in this clip was hand hygiene for Moment 5 at 5.8 seconds.
